content.title: What Happens in Spring? | Spring Facts for Kids
content.text: What happens in spring? 🌸🌦️ In this kid-friendly video, we learn about the spring season and the exciting changes that happen in nature! Kids will learn: Why the weather gets warmer Why flowers bloom Why animals have babies What happens when it rains and the sun shines Fun signs of spring Perfect for: ✔ Kindergarten ✔ Preschool ✔ Elementary students ✔ Classroom lessons ✔ Homeschool learning If you’re teaching about spring facts for kids or the four seasons, this video makes it simple and fun! 💛 Thanks for Watching Shon’s Stories!
